notes.title: [ANNOUNCEMENT] Crowdfunding Campaign Ends with Huge Success!
notes.content:
Thank you so much for supporting Spell Fragments!

The crowdfunding campaign has successfully concluded, and thanks to your generous support and word-of-mouth, I achieved an amazing result of [b]1,088 backers[/b] and a total of [b]16,835,404 yen[/b]!

I am beyond words with gratitude for having so many people cheer me on and for reaching 800% of the initial goal. Your support will be a tremendous driving force for the further evolution and advancement of Spell Fragments.

On the final day, we successfully reached the 800% stretch goal, confirming the addition of [b]Slash Magic[/b]! Combined with the previous stretch goals, I'm excited to deliver even more rich content when the game releases.

From here on, I will utilize your support to strengthen my development capacity while focusing all my efforts on adding game content and improving quality.


I regularly share updates on the Spell Fragments Official Discord Community.
[url=https://discord.gg/bcHJkqFktd]https://discord.gg/bcHJkqFktd[/url]
Please join us to interact with me as the developer and share magic creations with other players!


I express my deepest gratitude again for your warm support.

I will continue to do my absolute best to deliver the ultimate Spell Fragments experience as "a game you can be passionate about and truly enjoy"!
I look forward to your continued support for Spell Fragments!

notes.title: Only a Few Days Left! Our Crowdfunding Campaign is Ending Soon!
notes.content:
Thank you so much for your continued support of Spell Fragments!

Our ongoing crowdfunding campaign will end on [b]April 26th (Saturday) at 11:59 PM JST[/b].

Thanks to your incredible support, we have now gathered over 14 million yen. We are deeply grateful for your generosity!

Here are some of the rewards you can receive:
- Exclusive merchandise featuring new illustrations
- Early access to the game's alpha version
- The opportunity to add your own magic idea to the game
- Your name listed in the game credits and a special thank you section

The funds raised through this crowdfunding campaign will be used to enhance the game experience in the following areas:
- Adding more diverse magic, enemies, and dungeon content
- Creating original boss characters
- Improving graphics, controls, and UI quality
- Expanding our development team to deliver the game to you faster

Your warm support is crucial in making Spell Fragments a truly immersive and enjoyable game that you can lose yourself in.

There are only a few days left in the campaign, so if you're interested, please consider supporting us at this time. We hope to build the best possible game together with you!

Thank you for your continued support!

▼ Crowdfunding Page
https://camp-fire.jp/projects/824790/view


[Important Information for International Supporters]

Please note that the current crowdfunding page is in Japanese due to our development team's operational capacity. For those residing outside of Japan who are interested in physical rewards, kindly refer to the FAQ on the crowdfunding page for potential alternative shipping arrangements. We recommend using a translation tool to navigate the page.

For pledge tiers that include only digital rewards, such as the game itself or digital artbooks, supporters from any region should be able to contribute and receive these items without issue. Looking ahead, if we see significant interest from our international community, we are eager to explore options for making the currently offered physical rewards accessible to supporters in other regions. Please understand that this is a possibility for the future and not a guarantee.

notes.title: Crowdfunding Campaign Launch!
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of Spell Fragments!
We also appreciate your participation in our crowdfunding survey.

[h3]Crowdfunding:[/h3]
We are launching our crowdfunding campaign on February 6, 2025, at 9:00 PM (JST).

We have prepared various rewards, including exclusive merchandise featuring newly commissioned artwork, name recognition in both in-game and special credits, access to the game's alpha version, and the right to add your own magical spell to the game.

The funds raised through this crowdfunding campaign will primarily be used for the following development costs:
- Adding more spells, enemies, and dungeon content
- Adding boss characters with original designs
- Improving graphics, controls, and UI quality
- Expanding our development team to deliver the game to you sooner
(For other uses of funds, please see the details on the crowdfunding page)

Please consider supporting Spell Fragments to help us complete it as a high-quality game that you can "stay up all night playing and thoroughly enjoy," and deliver it as the best game possible.
We would be delighted to walk together with you through the upcoming history of Spell Fragments.

Thank you for your consideration.

▼Crowdfunding Page
https://camp-fire.jp/projects/824790/view


[h3]A Note About Global Crowdfunding:[/h3]
While our initial crowdfunding campaign is launching in Japan due to our current team size and operational capacity, the crowdfunding page can be accessed and translated using translation tools for our global community.

For our global community members who are interested in supporting the project: all digital rewards (including game access, credits, and digital content) can be provided worldwide without any restrictions. While we aren't able to handle international shipping directly, physical rewards can be delivered using proxy shipping services - please refer to the Q&A section on our crowdfunding page for details.

We deeply value your interest and are actively monitoring wishlist trends and community interest from different regions. Your support means a lot to us, and we will explore possibilities for expanded global crowdfunding opportunities as our team grows.

notes.title: First Official Trailer Released
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support!

Today, we're excited to release the first-ever game trailer for Spell Fragments!
The trailer showcases the game's core elements, including magical combat and the spell crafting system, bringing you a concentrated look at what makes our game special.
https://youtu.be/Yq0HF1nVW7s

We would be honored if you would subscribe to our YouTube channel to stay updated with our future videos.

notes.title: Spell Fragments - User Survey for Upcoming Crowdfunding
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued support of Spell Fragments!

Since our announcement in September 2024, we have been truly grateful for the tremendous interest and enthusiasm from so many players looking forward to our game. As a small development team, we're working hard to exceed our initial plans by improving quality and expanding content to create the best possible gaming experience.

Today, we're excited to announce the launch of our user survey and reveal details about [Spell Fragments: Forbidden Magic Edition] - an Alpha version planned as a reward for our upcoming crowdfunding campaign.

Survey Details:
- URL: [url=https://forms.office.com/r/2NeccX3ERE]https://forms.office.com/r/2NeccX3ERE[/url]
- Time required: About 10 minutes
- Deadline: January 31, 2025
- You can use translation tools (like Google Translate) to view the survey in your language
- Feel free to respond in your preferred language
- The survey includes details about the Forbidden Magic Edition

A Note About Global Crowdfunding:
Due to our current team size, we lack the administrative capacity to manage a large-scale global crowdfunding campaign and handle international merchandise shipping. Therefore, our initial crowdfunding campaign will begin in Japan. However, your feedback about the game and crowdfunding rewards in this survey will be valuable for our future plans beyond Japan.

We deeply value our global community's interest! Based on future wishlist trends and interest levels from different regions, we hope to explore the possibility of expanding our crowdfunding globally. If we plan additional regional crowdfunding campaigns, we will create more opportunities for feedback from players looking forward to the game.

We're committed to creating the best possible game together with everyone looking forward to Spell Fragments. Your feedback will help shape our game's future!

Thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts!
